```{r}
################################################################################
# Setup:
# Y = p(X)Z + g(X,A) + e
# E[e|Z,X] =0
# Suppose p(X)Z is known, Y_LZ = Y - p(X)Z
# Y_XZ = g(X,A) + e
# solve E[ (Y_LZ-g(A,X))*h(Z,X) ] = 0 for any h
# Target function = g(A,X) with target variable A,X
# Perturbing function = h(Z,X) with perturbing variable (Z,X)
################################################################################
```

```{r}
library(cubature)

# Testing
N=2000
nc=2
generator = single_gen_QIV(N)
y = generator$y
a = generator$a
z = generator$z
x1 = generator$x1
x2 = generator$x2
s <- rep(1:nc, each=N/nc)

y1 = generator$y1
y0 = generator$y0
  
Data = data.frame(x1,x2,a,z,y,s)

nuisance_df = QIV_SL(data_train = Data[s==1,],data_pred = Data[s==2,])


eval = Data[s==2,]

eval$psi=nuisance_df$psi
eval$phi=nuisance_df$phi_1

eval$psi_est=generator$psi[s==2]
eval$phi_est=generator$phi_1[s==2]

ggplot(data = eval) + geom_point(aes(x=x1,y=psi-psi_est))

mean((eval$psi-eval$psi_est)[eval$a==1]**2)

mean(eval$phi[eval$a==1])


# ATT from taking counterfactual means over treated
mean((generator$e_Y1-generator$e_Y0)[generator$a==1]/mean(generator$a==1))
# ATT from taking mean over psi function
mean(eval$psi[eval$a==1])
```

```{r}
### Plotting Results
AZ.factor = as.factor(paste0(A,Z))
levels(AZ.factor) = c("A0Z0","A0Z1","A1Z0","A1Z1")


# Checking Psi
df.bias = data.frame(A,Z,X,
                     phi_1.bias,
                     pi_1.bias,
                     pi_0.bias,
                     pz_x.bias,
                     pa_x.bias,
                     "AZ"=AZ.factor,
                     "tt" = ATT[["tt"]])
df.treated = df.bias[A==1,]
df.treated["psi.bias"]=psi.bias[A==1]

ggplot(data=df.treated) + geom_point(aes(x=X1,y=psi.bias,color = Z))


ggplot(data=df.bias) + geom_point(aes(x=X1,y=tt,color = AZ))


# Checking Phi_1
ggplot(data=df.bias) + geom_point(aes(x=X1,y=phi_1.bias,color=AZ.factor))
```
